idea-plugin.name: Intelli Webrunner
idea-plugin.description:
An alternative to Postman and Insomnia — directly inside IntelliJ IDEA.

No more switching between your IDE and external API testing tools. Test your application without leaving IntelliJ IDEA.

The plugin allows you to:

  • Send and test HTTP requests
  • Work with gRPC
  • Produce and consume Kafka messages
  • Run multiple requests sequentially
  • Use before-request and after-response scripts
  • Manage environment variables
  • Organize and reuse requests
  • Inspect responses directly inside the IDE

The plugin also includes a collection of useful developer tools, so you no longer need separate websites for common everyday tasks.

Decode JWT tokens, encode and decode Base64, get the current Unix timestamp, convert values and formats, and use many other developer utilities — all without leaving IntelliJ IDEA.

Keep your development, API testing, debugging, and everyday developer tools in one place.
